decisions.decision: Use Postmark for lifecycle emails instead of SendGrid.

reasoning.claim: Deliverability matters more than the small cost difference.

source.speaker: Nina Patel
source.quote: Reversing the earlier decision. Final decision: use Postmark for lifecycle emails instead of SendGrid. Deliverability matters more than the small cost difference. Marco still owns setup, and we need it ready before the onboarding launch on 2026-08-20.

reasoning.claim: SendGrid's cheaper tier does not include the dedicated IP package we need.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: Update: I checked the contract details. SendGrid's cheaper tier does not include the dedicated IP package we need, so the real cost difference is much smaller.

objections.claim: Using SendGrid again could cause delays because password-reset emails had delays last quarter.

source.speaker: Aisha Rahman
source.quote: I'm concerned about using SendGrid again because password-reset emails also had delays last quarter. Assuming deliverability matters more than the lower price, I would choose Postmark.

risks.claim: SendGrid had worse deliverability during the March campaign.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: SendGrid is cheaper for the first 100k emails, but deliverability was worse during the March campaign. Postmark is more expensive, but support said it had fewer spam-folder issues.
